## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `go build ./...` successfully
- [ ] I ran `go vet ./...` cleanly
- [ ] I ran `go test ./... -short -count=1` and all tests pass
- [ ] New/changed code is covered by tests where practical
- [ ] Code is formatted with `gofmt`
- [ ] I updated documentation where applicable
